risks.name: weaker_product_approval_side_door
risks.why_it_matters: A broad or inferred product approval could bypass the bridge's evidence-integrity boundary.
risks.mitigation: Require a bridge-specific Karl exact-content approval marker with source and approval hash binding.
risks.future_test_or_review_gate: Reject broad prereg approval and legacy operator approval in product mode.

risks.name: legacy_bridge_behavior_changed_accidentally
risks.why_it_matters: Legacy bridge evidence could drift without visible contract approval.
risks.mitigation: Keep legacy default unchanged and require byte-regression proof.
risks.future_test_or_review_gate: Before/after legacy invocation and byte/hash comparison.

risks.name: toolcontext_bypass
risks.why_it_matters: Wrong WP or role could gain bridge or runner authority.
risks.mitigation: Use explicit product-mode ToolContext allowlist and fail-closed checks.
risks.future_test_or_review_gate: Unsupported WP IDs and legacy/product cross-mode IDs are rejected.

risks.name: scratch_prefix_bypass
risks.why_it_matters: Product artifacts could escape package-local scratch discipline.
risks.mitigation: Bind source and output paths to active product scratch root.
risks.future_test_or_review_gate: Reject non-product source paths, output roots, and path traversal.

risks.name: product_approval_inferred_from_broad_prereg
risks.why_it_matters: Pipeline prereg approval is not bridge-specific approval.
risks.mitigation: Require separate bridge-preparation marker and reject broad prereg substitution.
risks.future_test_or_review_gate: Broad prereg marker without bridge marker fails product mode.

risks.name: bridge_shaped_output_fabrication
risks.why_it_matters: Product code could emit plausible bridge artifacts without bridge validation.
risks.mitigation: Bridge module owns validation and artifact generation.
risks.future_test_or_review_gate: Product mode proves bridge-owned validators ran and no product reimplementation emits bridge outputs.

risks.name: runner_invoked_during_prepare_only_path
risks.why_it_matters: Preparation would silently become execution without separate approval.
risks.mitigation: Product mode has no runner call path and no runner permission.
risks.future_test_or_review_gate: Spy/audit proves no _invoke_runner, no run_offline_sweep, no RUN_NONCANONICAL_OFFLINE_SWEEP.

risks.name: bridge_owned_validators_bypassed
risks.why_it_matters: Invalid Strategy Spec, Variant Manifest, or Sweep Plan artifacts could enter product evidence.
risks.mitigation: Product mode must run bridge-owned validator calls.
risks.future_test_or_review_gate: Validator failure rejects product mode and leaves no authoritative artifacts.

risks.name: denominator_review_packet_drift
risks.why_it_matters: Hidden failures or winner-only selection would corrupt review evidence.
risks.mitigation: Preserve denominator ledger and review packet requirements with non-authority fields.

risks.name: partial_artifact_leakage
risks.why_it_matters: Failed product preparation could leave ambiguous artifacts.
risks.mitigation: Fail closed and classify partial artifacts as scratch-only non-authoritative.
risks.future_test_or_review_gate: Failure leaves no canonical artifacts, no runner artifacts, and no candidate records.

risks.name: canonical_candidate_runtime_scheduler_provider_protected_authority_leakage
risks.why_it_matters: The product bridge path must not create downstream execution or authority.
risks.mitigation: Require explicit false flags and protected-path checks.
risks.future_test_or_review_gate: Approval with any true forbidden authority flag is rejected.

risks.name: future_wp_misreads_decision_packet_as_implementation_authorization
risks.why_it_matters: This packet is a proposal only.
risks.mitigation: Repeat non-authority assertions and Karl-gate language in docs, status, scratch, and PR body.
risks.future_test_or_review_gate: Future implementation package must cite explicit Karl approval before code changes.
